QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults to off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). Every mutex wrapper sits behind it, including the pthread implementation (`library/threading.c:18`, `:50`), which also needs `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros gating the mutex and threading code.
